game_guide.overview.db_section.descripti: <a1>Items</a1> — Comprehensive database that includes all items present in the game, with search and filtering capabilities. It also contains detailed changelogs for items for each game patch.
<a1>Skills</a1> — Detailed information for all skills. It also contains detailed changelogs for skills for each game patch.
<a1>Ailments</a1> — Detailed information for all ailments. It also contains detailed changelogs for ailments for each game patch.
game_guide.overview.description: This Game Guide provides details for the main game aspects, including Skills, Ailments, Items, Combat Mechanics and Minions, as well as Crafting and Endgame systems. game_guide.overview.tools_section.descri: <a1>Build Guides</a1> — A collection of comprehensive written build guides hosted on Last Epoch Tools. Anyone who is registered on the <a2>Forum</a2> can <a3>submit</a3> their build guides here, you just need to follow the guidelines.
<a1>Builds</a1> — Automatically updated collection of build guides from this site, YouTube and Last Epoch Forum.

<a1>Build Planner</a1> — A tool that allows you to customize any aspect of Last Epoch character build including equipment, idols, blessings, passives and skills. It also provides detailed info on character stats and allows you to generate loot filter for any build.

<a1>Loot Filters</a1> — A tool that allows you to create and edit loot filters outside of the game, manage your own loot filter collection and view loot filters shared by other players. It also features Filter Wizard that provides an easy and fast way to create a loot filter based on your choice of class, skills, equipment, damage types etc.
<a1>My Builds</a1> — A tool to manage your personal collection of Last Epoch character builds.
<a1>Checklist</a1> — Checklist for Important Quests, Timelines as well as Unique and Set Items.

endgame.left_panel.category_arenas_descr: There are two types of arenas available in the game currently.

The Endless Arena offers endless waves of foes with increasing difficulty. It is a competitive game mode that challenges your character. Your progress is tracked on the <a1>Ladder</a1>, so you may see where you stack up against the other players who have braved the Endless Arena.

The Arena of Champions is an alternative arena mode that has a limited number of waves and a Champion boss at the end. Arena of Champions has four tiers which have increasing challenge and rewards. While progressing through the waves, you will be presented with a choice of additional modifiers to further increase the difficulty and rewards.
endgame.left_panel.category_dungeons_des: Dungeons are endgame activities that provide both a special challenge and special rewards that can't be found anywhere else in the game. Each dungeon has a specific mechanic and an ability which will help you overcome specific challenges.
They require a specific key to access and are considered roguelike – if you die or leave the dungeon, your key is lost and you will need to start over.
Dungeons have four tiers which have increasing challenge and rewards.
endgame.left_panel.category_monolith_des: The Monolith of Fate is the main endgame system in Last Epoch. Characters can access the Monolith of Fate from the End of Time, though it is designed to be started after the campaign.
The Monolith of Fate consists of multiple Timelines. All Timelines have a fixed area level and their own set of layouts, enemies and quests to encounter.

Each Timeline contains Quest Echoes, which are milestones in progressing the story of the timeline. In the last (third) Quest Echo you'll encounter the Timeline's boss – killing it guarantees an item from its unique drop pool, and allows you to choose a blessing that provides permanent buff to your character.
Each boss has four unique or set items to offer: two common ones, one scaling with item rarity and a very rare one available only in Empowered timelines.
